subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should messages.tts.provider remain a preferred provider with automatic fallback to other configured providers, or should configured-provider auto TTS become sticky/fail-closed when the selected provider skips or fails?
rationale: Current source, docs, and tests intentionally preserve fallback behavior; resolving the issue by enforcing stickiness would change user-visible semantics and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Keep fallback, improve explanation
options.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain and close or narrow this issue after ensuring status/logs make provider changes unmistakable.

options.title: Make configured provider sticky by default
options.body: Change auto TTS so a configured provider failure does not use another provider unless maintainers accept the compatibility break and update docs/tests.

options.title: Add explicit strict mode
options.body: Keep fallback as the default but add a deliberate no-fallback policy only if maintainers want new config surface for strict provider behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep fallback, improve explanation
recommendation.body: Preserve the documented fallback chain and close or narrow this issue after ensuring status/logs make provider changes unmistakable.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects provider/plugin architecture and documented fallback policy, and Peter has central history on speech-provider registration and ownership refactors.
